scope: Proposition 6.1 (Interpolation of the reference dimension) of the manuscript “Cylinder loop weights and planar nesting” (preprints/Cylinder-loop-weights-and-planar-nesting-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2e5effc6ded13360), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 58. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix polynomial bounds on ne, ℓe, |M|. For every fixed b > 0 there is a jointly holomorphic function ˆ︁ F(ν, M), with ν = (ν+, ν−) ∈ C2, on a neighborhood of the indicated M-disk and the polydisk |νσ − m| ≤ √ m, such that | ˆ︁ F(ν, M)| ≤ exp(LC ), | ˆ︁ F(ν, M) − Fν(M)| ≤ e−Lb for ν ∈ Z2 ≥0 in the polydisk. (44) Here C is fixed after the truncation bounds and b are fixed. The bounds are uniform in the real explicit- particle positions on their labeled lines. The integrals include their reference masses Jν+ (w0)Jν− (w0), but no external phase factor.
